notes:
Lead source: organic sign-up + product hunt mention. Small B2B SaaS (SaaS billing + onboarding workflows) building an in-app chat assistant to handle support triage + lead qualification. Wants streaming responses (typing indicator) and low token-level latency for a native feel. Current prototype uses React + websockets; they already implemented a streaming client and observed 'choppy' partials under load. Quote from VP Eng: "Users abandon after 2s of no typing; streaming must feel instant."

Technical requirements / asks:
- Primary: Hosted API, streaming over websocket or SSE, SDK for quick integration (self-serve).
- Latency targets: median <150ms frontend-to-first-token desirable, p95 <400ms acceptable. Current measurements: median ~220ms, p95 ~380ms on trial keys.
- Throughput: baseline 8-12 qps, peaks 30-50 qps during business hours. Burst-friendly but cost-sensitive.
- Prompt characteristics: short prompts (60-200 tokens), responses ~20-120 tokens, high ratio of many concurrent short sessions.
- Caching: interested in prefix/KV caching for repeated flows.
- Model preference: open to Redwood-curated small open models (13B quantized) for cost but wants option to route to higher-quality model when context is long or for complex questions.
- Security: SOC2 required for customer trust; will need SSO/SAML for admin console before enterprise rollout. Audit logs and per-request metadata are important for compliance and debugging.
- Billing: wants visibility into per-route/per-token cost and a sandbox/demo billing estimate for 10k-50k tokens/week.

POC ask: 1-week hosted trial with monitoring (p50/p95/p99 latency), streaming jitter metrics, cost estimate. AE/SE agreed to provide trial config + sample prompts and to run Redwood test harness to reproduce streaming behavior.

Notes on objections: token pricing is the main hesitation (startup runway). Also internal Infosec needs confirmation on data handling in public cloud for EU customers (data residency question).
